content.text: {"who":"Operations managers, office managers, IT leads, and owner-operators at US and Canadian businesses with about 10 to 250 employees. They are not developers, and they live in Gmail or Outlook.","environment":"Systems that already send email: scheduling software, monitoring tools such as Datadog or Grafana, help desks, web forms, and equipment that emails alarms. Recipients are away from their desks when those emails arrive.","segments":[{"name":"Field service and facilities","reason":"Weekend rotations and early crews who are not at a desk when the alert email lands."},{"name":"IT teams and MSPs","reason":"Downtime and monitoring alerts, without an API project or a paging tool."},{"name":"Multi-site and regulated operations","reason":"Bank branches, healthcare offices, schools, and churches that must reach every site the same way."},{"name":"Broken carrier gateways","reason":"txt.att.net, tmomail.net, and vtext.com, including a Verizon shutdown in March 2027."}],"triggers":["A missed alert caused real damage over a weekend.","Their carrier email-to-text address stopped delivering.","They hit a 10DLC or registration wall.","A developer quote for an SMS API came back too expensive or too slow."],"values":["Setup in about 30 minutes","Nothing new for staff to learn","Replies land back in the inbox","Compliance handled for them","Predictable pricing at $29 to $49 a month"],"poorFit":[{"name":"SMS marketers","reason":"The page is about operational alerts, not promotional campaigns."},{"name":"Developers building SMS into a product","reason":"They want an API, not an email gateway."},{"name":"Teams that need acknowledgment and escalation","reason":"That work stays in a paging tool such as PagerDuty or Opsgenie."}]}
